_about: Values of section 9 of method-spec-2026-10-24.md (close choices), fixed before any close-choice number was computed. Never changed after results.
definition: A decision is a close choice when the second most likely play has at least half the probability of the first (internally: split).
label: Probabilities over plays, not sampled reasoning.

stage_b.primary: exact agreement of predicted and observed feature sets
stage_b.secondary: partial overlap |P and O| / |P or O|; 1 when both empty, 0 when exactly one empty
